answer.reason: The verses state what Haggai did beyond being a prophet: he prophesied to the builders of the house of God, and the people obeyed his words.

clauses.english: prophesied to the Jews, and the building of the house of God prospered through his prophesying
clauses.quote: they prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet

clauses.english: called on the people to rebuild the LORD's house, and Zerubbabel and the people obeyed his words
clauses.quote: obeyed the voice of the LORD their God, and the words of Haggai the prophet
